tools.name: docket_ask_website
tools.description: Ask a question about this company's product, pricing, integrations, security or implementation, and get an answer from the knowledge the company publishes for visitors. Prefer this over reading or scraping the page: it covers the whole site, not just what is on screen. It cannot book meetings or answer about anything other than this company. When a slide or video illustrates the answer, the result says so and carries show_content: this page can put it on the visitor's screen. Offer it to them, and if they want it call docket_open_website_agent with that starting_message. No image is returned and there is no link to render. Every result includes a conversation_id. Pass it back as conversation_id on the visitor's follow-up questions so the answer takes the earlier exchange into account; omit it to start a fresh conversation. An id expires after a period of inactivity: each result says when in conversation_note, and an expired one is replaced automatically with a new conversation_id rather than failing.

question.description: One question about this company or its product.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id from this tool's previous result. Pass it to continue the same conversation; omit it to start a new one. If it has expired, the result comes back with a new one to use from then on.

tools.name: docket_open_website_agent
tools.description: Open this company's live AI sales agent on the visitor's screen and start a conversation. The agent can show product slides and videos, answer follow-ups in real time, and help book a meeting. Use it when the visitor wants to talk to the company, see the product, or go deeper than a single answer — this is the next step after docket_ask_website. This changes what the visitor sees, so only call it when they have asked for it. With starting_message, the conversation opens on that message as if the visitor had typed it; without it the agent opens with its own greeting. mode is 'chat' (text, default) or 'voice' (spoken, needs a microphone). If a conversation is already open, this does nothing.

starting_message.description: The visitor's first message to the agent, in their words. Omit to let the agent open the conversation.

mode.description: 'chat' for text (default), 'voice' for a spoken call.
